facts.fact: BOCRA's schedule lists Orange Botswana's cheapest 30-day data plan of 5 GB or more as 8 GB for P99 (plan price), after the price cut following the May 2025 pricing and costing study; the document gives no day, so the year in its filename (2025) is used.

systems.country_label: e.g. 1 day 1.5GB P10; 7 days 4GB P50; 14 days 8GB P80

note: Table 2 also lists BTC 30-day 5GB at P112 and Mascom 30-day 6.5GB at P120; not recorded, being dearer than Orange's 8GB at P99.
